about: A raymarched still-life world from the shader library with flush-left type and a cinematic grade. Taste decision: asymmetric composition (type anchored bottom-left to a 6% margin, the world filling the rest), a 2-size serif statement, and a motivated light direction shared by type shadow and scene (TASTE.md §1, §3–4). Swap the shader for any library entry or your own GLSL. Don't use the stock primitives (spheres, tori) as the subject; model the brief's own forms in the SDF.
